tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind every view.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Tables, form fields and the sticky action bar. Sits on canvas.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Missing-artwork tiles, code-like values, table header rows, score-bar troughs.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules: table rows, section dividers, nav underline. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons (3:1 on canvas and surface in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on canvas, surface, surface-sunken and accent-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (metadata, captions, table headers) on canvas, surface and surface-sunken. At least 5.9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single accent: links, the one primary action per view, current nav item, focus ring. Text on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary buttons and links.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected table row and the current nav item's ground. Ink and accent text read on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label text on accent and accent-strong fills (dark text in dark mode, where accent is light).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard focus ring with 2px offset; 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Confident match, done, verified. Blue-teal so it is not told from danger by red/green hue; always paired with a glyph and a word. Text on canvas, surface, positive-tint.

tokens.name: positive-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a positive notice or status tag.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Needs review, uncertain evidence, warnings. Text on canvas, surface, caution-tint; always with a glyph and a word.

tokens.name: caution-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a caution notice or status tag.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, rejected matches, and destructive actions (trash, discard). Text on canvas, surface, danger-tint.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of an error notice or status tag.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label text on a filled danger button.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The page title (h1). One per page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Table headers, nav group names, field labels above inputs. Set in uppercase via CSS, never typed in caps.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Originals go to .trash and can be restored with Undo.
styles.usage: Default text, table cells, buttons, inputs.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Counts and consequences inside sentences; status words.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, captions, help text under fields.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Distances, scores, bitrates, durations, file paths, short MBIDs. Use tabular figures; right-align numbers in tables.

spacing.note: 4px base. Use headings and space before containers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to word inside a status tag; tight icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding (with space-3 horizontal); gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; input padding; label to control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; paragraph spacing; stacked form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gutter; heading to the content it introduces.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter from 48rem up; between subsections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between top-level sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above the page title; around empty states.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Tables, rules, the action bar, nav.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, status tags, score bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Artwork, notices, the only larger surfaces.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of main; centred.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running prose and explanatory paragraphs.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Columns from 48rem up; phones use one column.

tokens.name: breakpoint
tokens.usage: The single layout breakpoint (mobile-first).

tokens.name: art-xs
tokens.usage: Rows in request, watchlist and discover tables.

tokens.name: art-sm
tokens.usage: Review candidate header, plan headers: identity without crowding evidence.

tokens.name: art-md
tokens.usage: Watchlist follow and release detail on phones.

tokens.name: art-lg
tokens.usage: Discovery and release detail from 48rem up: artwork leads recognition.
